findings.passage: The enactment of SB 73 protects Californians’ sacred right to vote free from fear of intimidation or interference and safeguards the essential integrity of elections in California.
findings.note: Statement on her official site when SB 73 was signed. SB 73 limits law enforcement presence at voting places and access to voting machines and voter rolls. It does not address voter ID or proof of citizenship; saved as an election-integrity law in general.
subjects: law enforcement at polling places and voter-roll access

findings.motion: SB 73 (Cervantes), election interference protections, signed by the Governor
findings.note: Author of SB 73, which lets state officials object to law enforcement posted at voting sites or election offices, bars access to voting machines or voter rolls without a court order, and makes taking ballots from a county registrar a felony. Described on her official site.
